title: 给木屋找个位置
text: The new cottage needs a quiet place. Keep it away from the busy landing area. The western meadow has enough space, and a short path connects it to the forest. Let us build the cottage there.
zh: 木屋需要安静的位置，远离繁忙的停船区。西边草地空间充足，也有小路通向森林。把木屋建在那里。
sentence: Build the cottage away from the landing area.
sentence_zh: 把木屋建在远离停船区的地方。

title: 风从哪里来
text: The trees can block the wind. To keep the mill working, place it on the open hill rather than beneath the tall trees. Its sails need enough space to turn freely. The garden can remain below.
zh: 树木会挡风。把风车建在开阔的小山上，别放在大树下面。叶片需要足够空间自由转动，花园可以留在下方。
sentence: Place the mill on the open hill.
sentence_zh: 把风车建在开阔的山坡上。

title: 把水送进花园
text: The garden is almost ready, but its soil is dry. The windmill can power a small water pump. Connect the pump to the garden before opening the valve. Then the water will reach the plants instead of spilling onto the path.
zh: 花园快完工了，但土壤很干。风车能带动小水泵。先把水泵接到花园，再打开阀门，水就会流向植物而不是洒到小路上。
sentence: Connect the pump to the garden before opening the valve.
sentence_zh: 先把水泵接到花园，再打开阀门。
